meta.title: CyAI Orchestrator — an AI workspace for your projects
meta.description: Conversations, reusable agents, shared context and background missions in a local Windows workspace. Explore CyAI Orchestrator, its tools and its offline manual.
nav.label: Main navigation
chapters.label: Explore CyAI Orchestrator
hero.title: CyAI Orchestrator
hero.body: Keep shared context and background missions with your project files. Connect an AI provider or choose a local model, then work from one conversation.
hero.note: An Alpha for testing and feedback. Models and optional engines are downloaded separately.
conversation.alt: CyAI project conversation with a response, project navigation, message composer and team members
conversation.caption: Conversations and team members in Nebula Studio, a demonstration project.
flow.title: From a folder to reviewed work
flow.1.title: Choose a project
flow.1.body: Start from an existing folder. Keep its conversations, memory, skills and media together.
flow.2.title: Connect your AI
flow.2.body: Use a native provider, an API integration, Ollama or the integrated local engine.
flow.3.title: Describe the work
flow.3.body: Send text or files. Queue a follow-up while an agent works, or send it immediately.
flow.4.title: Review the result
flow.4.body: Follow task reports and execution details. Review deliverables before accepting them.
workspace.title: Choose the connection that fits the task.
workspace.body: Select an agent and model for a conversation. Provider connectors keep their own authentication and expose the capabilities they actually support. Your project context stays explicit.
workspace.item1: Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, Anthropic API, OpenRouter and local-model integrations.
workspace.item2: Context and subscription usage appear when supplied by the connector. Unknown values remain unavailable.
workspace.item3: Local GGUF engines, weights and voice components can be installed when you need them.
connectors.alt: CyAI connector settings with provider cards and the integrated local engine
connectors.caption: Connector settings in the demo instance. Provider states are sample data, not account verification.
agents.title: Assign work. Follow it through to review.
agents.body: Reusable profiles define an agent's role, model and instructions. Project teams assign that work; the task board keeps reports and review decisions alongside progress.
board.title: See the work and its next step.
board.body: Track assignments, work in progress and reports awaiting review. An orchestration plan can run independent branches while dependent tasks wait for their prerequisites.
board.alt: CyAI task board with seven demonstration tasks arranged by progress and review status
board.caption: Assignments and review on the task board. Task content is demonstration data.
profiles.title: Reuse a profile across projects.
profiles.body: Keep role, connector and instructions in a versioned profile. Assign a profile revision to a team, or start an independent direct conversation.
profiles.alt: CyAI agent library with Artist, Developer, Planner and Reviewer profiles
profiles.caption: Reusable agent profiles with synthetic roles and model selections.
agents.note: Parallel execution depends on providers and task dependencies. The integrated local engine processes one model request at a time.
tools.title: Bring the tools your project needs.
tools.body: Keep standalone CyTools separate from project plugins. Add an installed folder or connect a supported package, then expose the relevant tools to your agents.
tools.item1: The current CyTools catalogue covers AudioStudio, AudioLibrary, AIChat, PersonaRP, Storyboard and MeshStudio.
tools.item2: CyAnnota and CyMD editors are integrated; CyAICodex and CyTask can extend project workflows.
tools.item3: Register local MCP servers such as Blender. Only enabled plugins declaring a project view become project tabs.
cytools.alt: CyAI CyTools settings with the six official tool applications
cytools.caption: The official CyTools catalogue. External apps, engines and model weights are installed separately.
details.title: The everyday details stay within reach.
details.files.title: Files and previews
details.files.body: Send attachments without text. Open images and videos in the app; inspect supported 3D files with PBR materials, backgrounds and lighting presets.
details.memory.title: Context you can inspect
details.memory.body: Shared memory and skills make project context explicit. Conversation history and mission events persist locally in SQLite.
details.logs.title: Trace what happened
details.logs.body: Read the journal, raw events and MCP operations. Inspect connector status and available CPU, RAM, GPU and VRAM history.
documentation.title: Explore it here. Keep it offline.
documentation.body: Open the same CyDoc reader supplied with the application. This showcase includes the complete manual: English and French, topic navigation, search, screenshots, diagrams, themes and in-window image enlargement.
documentation.shortcuts: In the app, use F1 for contextual help or select Documentation in the left rail. Reading the manual does not call an AI.
manual.alt: CyAI CyDoc manual with topic navigation, header search and the Start here guide
manual.caption: The actual CyAI manual, with English and French editions and local resources.
availability.title: Try the Windows Alpha.
availability.body: CyAI Orchestrator {version} is available as a Windows x64 installer. Alpha features may be incomplete and workflows may change before a stable release.
availability.item1: Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime must be available. The installer is not digitally signed.
availability.item2: Provider connections require their own authentication. API credit is separate from an app subscription.
availability.item3: Models and optional engines are downloaded explicitly. Memory requirements depend on the selected model.
availability.item4: This release has no published Linux or macOS installer.
faq.title: A few practical questions
faq.1.a: The workspace, history, media previews and bundled manual are local. Downloaded local models can run without a cloud provider. Online providers, initial downloads and external services need a connection.
faq.2.q: Can every task run in parallel?
faq.2.a: Independent mission branches can run concurrently, subject to provider capabilities and limits. Dependent tasks wait for prerequisites. The integrated local inference engine handles one model request at a time.
faq.3.q: Are models included in the installer?
faq.3.a: Large model weights and optional engines are separate downloads, managed through Local models, Voice or Downloads. External CyTools manage their own dependencies and models.
faq.4.q: Does stopping an agent restore my files?
faq.4.a: No. Stop cancels the active response; it does not undo file changes already made. Portable application backups also exclude project working files, credentials and provider-native sessions. Back up your project folders separately.
faq.5.q: Which language does the app use?
faq.5.a: English is the default. Select French under Settings → Appearance → Interface language. Switching preserves drafts and running work; user documents, project names and model responses keep their original language.
